description: Logical channel contracts. Actual Hands broker records use hands-wire.schema.json (ManagedBatchCodec v2); Session Service compiles generic operations into this existing durable transport. Java retains Ready/Resume consumption; TypeScript reads the durable queue through executions/next.

channels.ack: Durable admission and capacity-bound claim before ACK; start provider work after ACK confirmation.
channels.ordering: At least once; stable messageId/executionId; no assumed FIFO.

channels.ack: Persist cancellation before ACK; replay is output delivery only. Neither control may create execution.
channels.ordering: May precede Execute. A cancellation must survive until Execute arrives.

channels.ack: ACK after durable receive/deduplication (buffered is allowed); accept final result only after output coverage, with eligible durable wakeup.
channels.ordering: Sequence per scope/taskId/executionId; preserve gaps and detect conflicting duplicate identities.

channels.ack: Durable capacity-bound takeover or persisted deferral of the original intent; validated stale/duplicate deliveries may finish.
channels.ordering: A duplicate is not another run; validate suspension identity and epoch.

channels.ack: Resolve the current eligible queued Turn, then durably claim or defer; a validated empty/stale queue notice may finish.
channels.ordering: Ready is session-scoped. It deliberately has no turnId; claim binds the eligible Turn.
